newsitem.title: THAILAND: Toyota sees car sales rising in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Toyota sees car sales rising in Thailand.

text.p: Toyota Motors Thailand said on Friday it expected its car sales in Thailand this year to rise to 180,000 units compared with 163,940 units in 1996.
"We expect to have a market share of over 30 percent this year or 180,000 units sold" said Yoshiaki Muramatsu, president of Toyota Motors (Thailand) Corp at a news conference.
Toyota said car sales in 1997 will be supported by strong demand for its Soluna model launched in late January.
"We estimate that about 50,000 units of Soluna models will be sold each year," Muramatsu said

However the growth in overrall Thai car market was expected to be lower than last year as the national economy slowed, he added. The Thai economy has turned sluggish under various pressures including high interest rates, financial sector turmoil and slowing exports growth.
"I dont think total car sales this year will be higher than last year," he said
In 1996 about 590,000 cars were sold in Thailand.
